description: MCP server wiring for KlickSmartAI Open Cowork instance. Aligned with Hermes Agent stack (Brave/Serper/Exa/DataForSEO) and Google Workspace + GitHub integrations used by KlickSmartAI OS Schematic, Chief of Staff Briefing, and Spectra Census Research skills.

tavily.description: Primary web search. Use for general research, news, and fast lookups. Rate limit: 20 req/min on research endpoint.

exa.description: Deep semantic search. Use for financial services, CDFI, investment, and complex multi-angle research. Use 'deep' (4-12s) or 'deep-reasoning' (12-50s) modes.

firecrawl.description: Web scraping and crawling. Use for full-page extraction, structured data pulls, and bulk crawling with anti-bot bypass.

dataforseo.description: SEO intelligence. Use for client SEO audits and competitive research.

github.description: GitHub integration for KlickSmartAI-wiki repo operations, PR workflows, and code review. Authenticated as Ksdeng1559.

google_workspace.description: Google Workspace integration. Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Docs. Cowork-managed OAuth for token refresh.

search_rotation_policy.description: KlickSmartAI search engine rotation. Never retry a credit-exhausted engine. Rotation triggered on 429/402 or explicit credit error.

notes: Consumed by Open Cowork MCP discovery, which scans .claude/mcp_servers.json in the project root.
API keys are stored in Cowork encrypted credentials store, NOT in this file. The env field references variable names in Cowork env config.
Token refresh for Google Workspace is handled by Cowork OAuth UI.
GitHub PAT fallback: if GITHUB_PAT env is not set, Cowork reads from ~/.hermes/github-pat.txt (Windows: C:\Users\denni\.hermes\github-pat.txt).
If a server API key is not configured, set enabled to false rather than removing the block.
